Overlord (LN)

Experience the official release of **Overlord (LN)** online. After announcing it will be discontinuing all service, the internet game `Yggdrasil' shut down… That was the plan, but for some reason, the player character did not log out some time after the server was closed.

He leads his guild `Ainz Ooal Gown' towards an unprecedented legendary fantasy adventure!
